Wenzhou Special Transformer Power Distribution Project

This project is a special transformer undertaking by Wenzhou Civil Engineering Construction in Zhejiang Province. Yanghua's flexible busbar was used to connect the transformer to the low-voltage cabinet, adapting to the unique requirements of special transformer power distribution and large current scenarios. Unlike rigid busbars that require pre-bending and factory customization, the flexible busbar offers a cut-and-use approach. It can be turned directly during laying without any need for advance bending or shaping, flexibly conforming to on-site routing paths. This capability makes construction highly efficient and convenient while maintaining a clean, professional, and visually neat installation appearance.

Project Background & Challenges

The special transformer project required connecting transformers to low-voltage cabinets with large current capacity, but the on-site routing paths were irregular and the rigid busbar solution would have demanded extensive pre-bending, factory customization, and complex installation work.

  • Irregular on-site routing paths unsuitable for rigid pre-bent busbar solutions
  • Large current requirements demanded robust conductor capacity in a flexible form factor
  • Rigid busbar would have required time-consuming factory pre-bending and customization cycles
  • Need for a visually clean and orderly installation in a professional building environment

Solution

Yanghua's flexible busbar enables a cut-and-use installation approach, turning directly along on-site paths without pre-bending or factory pre-customization, delivering both installation efficiency and a neat, professional finished appearance.

  • Cut-and-use flexible busbar allows on-site length adjustment without factory pre-processing
  • Direct turning capability eliminates the need for pre-bending, adapting instantly to installation paths
  • Flexible form factor accommodates real-time routing changes during construction without rework
  • Neat, compact appearance ensures professional visual finish even in exposed installation areas
